24605-gleams-of-sunshine-optimistic-poem.title: Optimistic Poems
24605-gleams-of-sunshine-optimistic-poem.creator: Joseph Horatio Chant
24605-gleams-of-sunshine-optimistic-poem.description: A book by Joseph Horatio Chant. _O Thou, who art the source of joy and light,   The great Revealer of the will Divine; Thyself Divine, all nature owns Thy might,   And bows in homage at a beck of Thine, Afford me light to guide my unskilled hand, And by Thy Spirit all my thoughts command.

30988-the-junkmakers.title: The Junkmakers
30988-the-junkmakers.creator: Unknown
30988-the-junkmakers.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. cybernetics engineer and machine tender, he was down to ten hours a week of work. Many others in the luxury-gorged economy had even smaller shares of the purposeful activities that remained. At night he dreamed of the slagger moving from house to house as it burned, melted and then evaporated each group of junked labor-blocking devices.

arxiv-2103-08659.title: Function approximation by deep neural networks with parameters { 0 , ± 1 2 , ± 1 , 2 } \{0,\pm\frac{1}{2},\pm 1,2\}
arxiv-2103-08659.description: Abstract In this paper it is shown that C β C_{\beta} -smooth functions can be approximated by deep neural networks with ReLU activation function and with parameters { 0 , ± 1 2 , ± 1 , 2 } \{0,\pm\frac{1}{2},\pm 1,2\} . The l 0 l_{0} and l 1 l_{1} parameter norms of considered networks are thus equivalent.

arxiv-2306-08506.title: Probabilistic Regular Tree Priors for Scientific Symbolic Reasoning
arxiv-2306-08506.creator: Tim Schneider, Amin Totounferoush, Wolfgang Nowak, Steffen Staab
arxiv-2306-08506.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Tim Schneider, Amin Totounferoush, Wolfgang Nowak, Steffen Staab. Symbolic Regression (SR) allows for the discovery of scientific equations from data. To limit the large search space of possible equations, prior knowledge has been expressed in terms of formal grammars that characterize subsets of arbitrary strings. However, it is very challenging to formalize the aggregation of two or more items of prior knowledge, because context-free grammars are not closed under intersection.

arxiv-2309-08105.title: LIBRIHEAVY: A 50,000 HOURS ASR CORPUS WITH PUNCTUATION CASING AND CONTEXT
arxiv-2309-08105.creator: Wei Kang, Xiaoyu Yang, Zengwei Yao, Fangjun Kuang, Yifan Yang, Liyong Guo, Long Lin, Daniel Povey
arxiv-2309-08105.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Wei Kang, Xiaoyu Yang, Zengwei Yao, Fangjun Kuang, Yifan Yang, Liyong Guo, Long Lin, Daniel Povey. In this paper, we introduce Libriheavy, a large-scale ASR corpus consisting of 50,000 hours of read English speech derived from LibriVox. To the best of our knowledge, Libriheavy is the largest freely-available corpus of speech with supervisions. Different from other open-sourced datasets that only provide normalized transcriptions, Libriheavy contains richer information such as punctuation, casing and text context, which brings more flexibility for system building.

arxiv-2409-18723.title: On the flows of linear vector fields
arxiv-2409-18723.creator: M. Jotz
arxiv-2409-18723.description: Abstract . This note provides a detailed proof of the fact that a linear vector field on a vector bundle has a flow by vector bundle isomorphisms. It then implies easily the existence of global solutions to linear non-autonomous ODE’s, with a standard time-dependent flow construction.

arxiv-2412-17667.title: VERSA: A Versatile Evaluation Toolkit for Speech, Audio, and Music
arxiv-2412-17667.creator: Jiatong Shi, Hyejin Shim, Jinchuan Tian, Siddhant Arora, Haibin Wu, Darius Petermann, Jia Qi Yip, You Zhang, Yuxun Tang, Wangyou Zhang, Dareen Alharthi, Yichen Huang, Koichi Saito, Jionghao Han, Yiwen Zhao, Chris Donahue, Shinji Watanabe
arxiv-2412-17667.description: Abstract In this work, we introduce VERSA , a unified and standardized evaluation toolkit designed for various speech, audio, and music signals. The toolkit features a Pythonic interface with flexible configuration and dependency control, making it user-friendly and efficient. With full installation, VERSA offers 65 metrics with 729 metric variations based on different configurations.

arxiv-2501-02776.title: Conditioning to avoid bounded sets for a one-dimensional Lévy processes
arxiv-2501-02776.description: Abstract For several classes of bounded sets A A , the limit of a one-dimensional Lévy process conditioned to avoid A A up to a parametrized random time which tends to infinity. For A A we take the set of finite points with several clocks and a bounded F σ F_{\sigma} -set with exponential clock.

arxiv-2509-03106.title: Silicon-monoxide flames: the nucleation and condensation of silica fume
arxiv-2509-03106.creator: Nils Erland L. Haugen, Axel Brandenburg, Bernd Friede, Rolf G. Birkeland
arxiv-2509-03106.description: Abstract Silica fume is a valuable by-product from the silicon and ferrosilicon production. It is therefore important to understand the impact on the silica fume quality when converting the furnace feed from fossil-based to renewable reduction materials. Using self-consistent numerical simulations of the nucleation and condensation process, we present a detailed study of the silica fume formation process.

arxiv-2512-22806.title: On Composite Foster Functions for a Class of Singularly Perturbed Stochastic Hybrid Inclusions
arxiv-2512-22806.creator: Jorge I. Poveda, Mahmoud Abdelgalil
arxiv-2512-22806.description: Abstract We study sufficient conditions for stability and recurrence in a class of singularly perturbed stochastic hybrid dynamical systems. The systems considered combine multi–time-scale deterministic continuous-time dynamics, modeled by constrained differential inclusions, with discrete-time dynamics described by constrained difference inclusions subject to random disturbances.

arxiv-2602-06835.title: The Aronson-Bénilan estimate for a Lagrangian particle discretization of the Porous Medium Equation
arxiv-2602-06835.creator: Marco Di Francesco, Daniel Matthes
arxiv-2602-06835.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Marco Di Francesco, Daniel Matthes. We consider a nearest neighbor, Lagrangian particle discretization of the one dimensional porous medium equation. We prove that the particle model satisfies a discrete analog of the celebrated Aronson-Bénilan estimate, which we use to prove a growth estimate for the evolution of the support and an L ∞ L^{\infty} decay estimate which are both known to hold in the continuum. These estimates are uniform with respect to the number of particles.

arxiv-2602-10212.title: Rank-Accuracy Trade-off for LoRA: A Gradient-Flow Analysis
arxiv-2602-10212.creator: Michael Rushka, Diego Klabjan
arxiv-2602-10212.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Michael Rushka, Diego Klabjan. Previous empirical studies have shown that LoRA achieves accuracy comparable to full-parameter methods on downstream fine-tuning tasks, even for rank-1 updates. By contrast, the theoretical underpinnings of the dependence of LoRA’s accuracy on update rank remain relatively unexplored. In this work, we compare the accuracy of rank- r r LoRA updates against full-parameter updates for fine-tuning tasks from a dynamical systems perspective.

pmc-11436608.title: Gut commensal Alistipes as a potential pathogenic factor in colorectal cancer
pmc-11436608.creator: Jingjing Fu, Guangyao Li, Xiaoping Li, Shasha Song, Lijuan Cheng, Beibei Rui, Lei Jiang
pmc-11436608.description: Although previous research has shown that inflammation is associated with development of colorectal cancer (CRC), questions remain about whether inflammatory factor-secreting bacteria play a crucial role in CRC development. The potential role of gut microbiota in secreting inflammatory factors involved in the carcinogenesis of CRC among Chinese patients was explored in this study.

pmc-11440249.title: Berberine alleviates ETEC-induced intestinal inflammation and oxidative stress damage by optimizing intestinal microbial composition in a weaned piglet model
pmc-11440249.creator: Yue Wang, Ziting Zhang, Min Du, Xu Ji, Xiaodan Liu, Chunfang Zhao, Xunsheng Pang, Erhui Jin, Aiyou Wen, Shenghe Li, Feng Zhang
pmc-11440249.description: IntroductionEnterotoxigenic Escherichia coli (ETEC) is the main diarrhea-causing pathogen in children and young animals and has become a global health concern. Berberine is a type of “medicine and food homology” and has a long history of use in China, particularly in treating gastrointestinal disorders and bacterial diarrhea.

pmc-11716423.title: Prediction of amyloid and tau status in nondemented older adults using tree‐based ensemble models
pmc-11716423.creator: Younghoon Seo, Hwamee Oh
pmc-11716423.description: BackgroundPredicting amyloid and tau status in nondemented older adults with AD pathologies using more affordable and accessible measures can facilitate clinical trials by reducing the screen failure rate. The goal of the present study was to develop tree‐based ensemble models to predict PET‐based amyloid and tau burden using non‐invasive measures.

pmc-13107205.title: A poly(trisulfide) oligomer with antimicrobial activity
pmc-13107205.creator: Jasmine M. M. Pople, Ocean E. Clarke, Romy A. Dop, Thomas P. Nicholls, Harshal D. Patel, Witold M. Bloch, Zhongfan Jia, Sara J. Fraser-Miller, Evangeline C. Cowell, Jillian M. Carr, Daniel R. Neill, Joanne L. Fothergill, Bart A. Eijkelkamp, Tom Hasell, Justin M. Chalker
pmc-13107205.description: Antimicrobial resistance is a growing threat to human health and agriculture. Sulfur-containing compounds and elemental sulfur have a long history as antimicrobials, but challenges related to solubility have limited their use. Recent advances in sulfur polymer chemistry have enabled the development of novel sulfur-rich materials with antimicrobial activity.

pmc-13205718.title: Sulfakinin Signaling Sense Circulating Fructose and Suppresses Food Consumption via Insulin‐Like Peptide in Bactrocera Dorsalis
pmc-13205718.creator: Hong‐Fei Li, Bao Dong, Zheng‐Lin Ren, Xue‐Guang Zhu, Quan Lei, Yoonseong Park, Jin‐Jun Wang, Hong‐Bo Jiang
pmc-13205718.description: Feeding in animals is primarily regulated by the internal satiety state. Sulfakinin (Sk) is well known as a satiety signal that inhibits feeding. However, the underlying mechanism activating the Sk release is not yet fully understood, although the Sk for inhibitions of peripheral sensory systems, gustatory sweet and olfactory food smell sensors, were previously described.

pmc-13241633.title: Residual Wrist Pain and Cyst Recurrence Following Removal of Dorsal Ganglion With and Without Posterior Interosseous Nerve Neurectomy
pmc-13241633.creator: Charles T. Furlong, Henry L. Stanton, Riujie Yin, Michael W. Kessler, Curtis M. Henn
pmc-13241633.description: PurposePain from dorsal wrist ganglion cysts may result from irritation of the terminal branch of the posterior interosseous nerve. Excision of this branch is often used to treat wrist pain from various etiologies, including recurrent dorsal wrist cysts. This study examines the effect of performing concurrent posterior interosseous nerve neurectomy (PINN) during primary cyst excision.
